Name: GRASS_LOD_RANGE_PARAM_ST
Description: Distances of the three grass LOD levels. Each level runs out to its Switch Distance, then fades over its Fade Length, so it ends at Distance + Fade Length. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 0: Switch Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which the drawing method set for LOD 0's cluster type (Model, Billboard, FlatTuft and so on) switches to the next level. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 0: Fade Length
Fields.Description: Fade margin after LOD 0: Switch Distance: the level fades out over this length and ends at Distance + this value. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 1: Switch Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which the drawing method set for LOD 1's cluster type (Model, Billboard, FlatTuft and so on) switches to the next level. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 1: Fade Length
Fields.Description: Fade margin after LOD 1: Switch Distance: the level fades out over this length and ends at Distance + this value. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 2: Switch Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which the drawing method set for LOD 2's cluster type (Model, Billboard, FlatTuft and so on) switches to the next level. In metres.

Fields.Name: LOD 2: Fade Length
Fields.Description: Fade margin after LOD 2: Switch Distance: the level fades out over this length and ends at Distance + this value. In metres.
